audit.root_cause: The wheel puts a bare top-level __init__.py (which does a relative import) and age_predict.py into site-packages and ships no `age_experiment` module, so `vf-eval age-experiment` cannot import the env.
audit.evidence: pyproject.toml `[tool.hatch.build.targets.wheel] packages=["."] only-include=["age_predict.py","__init__.py"]`; __init__.py:8 `from .age_predict import ...`; load log: `site-packages/__init__.py line 8 ... ImportError: attempted relative import with no known parent package`. Our probe failed on the stray __init__ before reaching age_predict, but vf-eval would look for `age_experiment`, which does not exist.
audit.irl_fix: Package it as `age_experiment/` (with __init__.py and age_predict.py) or rename the module to age_experiment.py.
